title: Really Not Pleased
text: Really Not Pleased. It seemed like a great thing and the reviews are good but I wasn't pleased at all. It was hard to use in my opinion and having to switch out the blades became cumbersome quickly. Also, I tried to dice potatoes and unless they were super thin, it wasn't happening. I did like the glove included. It could just be me and my tastes, but it was not a good value to me and will probably just sit in the cabinet.
